clue.text: Model class

definitions.meaning: a model is a type or pattern, as in a style of car
a class at school, especially in British schools, is a year group

explanation.surface: A description of an exemplary group of pupils.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: a shape or type that serves as a pattern, and a school year group as British schools call it.

clue.text: A row — it upset the queen

indicators.note: upset means knocked over, so the little word is turned backwards here

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the standard abbreviation for the queen

explanation.surface: An argument that offended the monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns IT round to TI; ER (Elizabeth Regina) follows.
explanation.definitionFit: A tier is one level or rank in a stepped series, a row like seating in a theatre.

clue.text: Puts a stop to tips being given

definitions.meaning: tips are the extremities or points of things

explanation.surface: Someone abolishing the giving of gratuities.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means concludes; as a plural noun it means extremities, the points at either side.

clue.text: A break to take a course

parts.note: to take something is to get it
a course is a way or route

explanation.surface: A holiday spent taking a training course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'break' suggests a holiday, and it is also an escape, as in a prison break.
explanation.definitionFit: An escape from captivity, or a short holiday, is a break in both senses.

clue.text: Hurtful, but might be nicer in good situation

indicators.note: in signals one piece placed within the other

parts.note: pious means devout or good

indicators.note: might be suggests the letters of nicer could form something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: Something harmful which could still be pleasant in the right circumstances.
explanation.walkthrough: 'might be' rearranges NICER to ERNIC, and 'in' puts that inside PIOUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Pernicious means harmful or destructive, close in sense to hurtful.

clue.text: Still without a subject for discussion?

parts.note: a motion is a proposal put forward for debate
less means lacking, as in the suffix of homeless

explanation.surface: A debating society meeting where nothing is proposed.
explanation.walkthrough: The parts come in reverse order: 'without' gives LESS, which goes after MOTION.
explanation.definitionFit: Still as an adjective means not moving at all, unmoving.

clue.text: Only in the cellar will this serve

definitions.text: Only in the cellar will this serve

parts.words: Only in the cellar will this serve
parts.note: the cellar is not a wine store but a small table dish for salt, and this item is a tiny implement used only to serve from it

explanation.surface: A bottle that is good only for drinking in the basement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cellar' suggests wine, but a salt cellar is a small dish holding salt at table.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny spoon for taking salt from a table salt cellar.

clue.text: Street 'in Paris many deplored

parts.note: rue is the French word for street
D is the Roman numeral for 500, a crossword sense of many

explanation.surface: Many Parisians lamented their street.
explanation.definitionFit: Rued means regretted bitterly, the same as deplored.

clue.text: Set forth about now

parts.note: re means concerning, as in business letters
the present is the time now

explanation.surface: Explaining something on the subject of the current moment.
explanation.definitionFit: To set forth a case is to state or portray it, as a lawyer does for a client.

clue.text: Plant producing a variety of materials

indicators.note: a variety suggests the letters of materials in a different arrangement

explanation.surface: A factory turning out an assortment of fabrics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a variety of' rearranges MATERIALS.
explanation.definitionFit: Mare's tail is a water plant with whorled leaves, also a name for horsetail.

clue.text: A listening device some army units use

definitions.text: A listening device some army units use

parts.words: A listening device some army units use
parts.note: not electronic surveillance kit but the organ of hearing every soldier has

explanation.surface: Bugging equipment employed by military intelligence.
explanation.definitionFit: The organ of hearing is literally a natural device for listening.

clue.text: Boat obtainable for a pound in Ireland

definitions.meaning: a flat-bottomed boat pushed with a pole, as on the rivers at Oxford and Cambridge
the Irish pound before the euro was called by its Irish name

explanation.surface: A boat that could be bought cheaply in Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat-bottomed boat propelled with a pole, and the old Irish currency unit, Ireland's pound.

clue.text: The high spot in any actor's career

indicators.note: in tells us the letters sit within the words that follow

explanation.surface: The peak moment of a performer's working life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' points inside 'actor's'; 'high spot' means a hilltop, not a career peak.
explanation.definitionFit: A tor is a rocky hill or peak, especially on Dartmoor, so a high place.

clue.text: People keeping watch for Asian drug distributors

indicators.note: distributors spread things around, so the letters of the two words are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: Police watching for drug dealers from Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distributors' rearranges ASIAN and DRUG together.
explanation.definitionFit: Guardians are protectors who watch over others.

clue.text: Commercial transport of excellent kind

definitions.meaning: a railway train carrying freight rather than passengers
a fine variety or breed, as of plants or animals

explanation.surface: A superior type of delivery vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is entered as two five-letter words, read once as a freight train and once as a fine strain.
explanation.definitionFit: A freight train is the British name for a railway carrying merchandise; a fine breed is a superior lineage.

clue.text: Bother anyone can cause

indicators.note: cause here hints at making something new from the letters, which are reworked

explanation.surface: Trouble that anybody is able to stir up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cause' rearranges ANYONE and CAN together.
explanation.definitionFit: Bother as a noun means irritation or nuisance.

clue.text: Amusing individual going down with little sound

parts.note: a diver is someone who descends into water
a ting is a small ringing noise

explanation.surface: A funny person sinking with a tiny noise.
explanation.definitionFit: Diverting means entertaining, turning the mind pleasantly.

clue.text: Eat out and others start harping on

parts.note: etc is short for et cetera, and others

indicators.note: start points to the opening letter of the word harping

explanation.surface: Dining out while others keep going on about something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'start' takes the H of 'harping'. 'Eat out' looks like dining out; it is to corrode, as acid eats into metal.
explanation.definitionFit: Acid corrodes a metal plate to cut a design, so it eats away the surface.

clue.text: Overlook hotel back in bay

indicators.note: in signals one piece placed within the other

parts.note: a cove is a small bay

indicators.note: back means the word inn is read in reverse

parts.note: an inn is a small hotel

explanation.surface: A hotel looking out over a bay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns INN to NNI and 'in' places that inside COVE.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn a blind eye to wrongdoing is to overlook it tacitly.

clue.text: A lack of enthusiasm for bedroom-tidying

indicators.note: tidying means rearranging things, so the letters of bedroom are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A teenager's reluctance to clean their room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tidying' rearranges BEDROOM.
explanation.definitionFit: Weariness from lack of interest is an absence of enthusiasm.

clue.text: Suggested a rogue wasn't telling the truth

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous rascal
lied means spoke falsely

explanation.surface: A scoundrel is accused of lying.
explanation.definitionFit: Implied means hinted at indirectly.

clue.text: Grey's written an article on retiring

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
retiring means bashful or shy

explanation.surface: Grey has written a piece about being shy.
explanation.walkthrough: Grey looks like a writer's name; 's means 'is', and the definition is the colour, pale like ash.
explanation.definitionFit: Ashy means pale and grey in colour, like cinders.

clue.text: Thinks to show spirit in a set-back

parts.note: rum is an alcoholic spirit

indicators.note: back means the word set is read in reverse

parts.note: a set is a group or collection

explanation.surface: Someone reflecting on whether to show courage after a reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set-back' looks like one word for a reverse; split it, and 'back' turns SET to TES.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruminates means ponders or mulls over, as a cow chews the cud.

clue.text: Had a meal-tea possibly

indicators.note: possibly suggests the letters of tea may form another word when rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone had a meal, perhaps afternoon tea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges TEA.
explanation.definitionFit: Ate is the past tense of eat, to have food.

clue.text: A work-out's fitting

parts.note: PT is physical training, an exercise session; the 's stands for is

explanation.surface: Someone saying exercise is appropriate.
explanation.definitionFit: Apt means suitable or appropriate.

clue.text: Rushed round first to get the port

indicators.note: first says the round piece comes before the other

parts.note: O is a round shape
ran means went quickly

explanation.surface: A sailor hurried round to reach the harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: Oran is a port city in Algeria.
explanation.definitionFit: Oran is a major Algerian Mediterranean harbour city.

clue.text: One twice left a twit apprehensive

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: twice means the letter for left is written two times

parts.note: to twit is to tease or taunt

explanation.surface: Someone nervous after leaving a fool behind twice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twit' looks like a noun for a fool; it is the verb, to taunt.
explanation.definitionFit: Ill at ease means uneasy or nervous, as apprehensive people are.

clue.text: Nurse attaches number to key

parts.note: ten is a number
D is a musical key

explanation.surface: A nurse links a number to a key.
explanation.definitionFit: To tend someone is to look after or care for them.

clue.text: The medico goes in like a man

indicators.note: goes in tells us one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: as means in the manner of
MO is a medical officer, an army doctor

explanation.surface: A doctor arrives looking like a man.
explanation.walkthrough: Amos is a man's name, and a prophet of the Old Testament.
explanation.definitionFit: Amos is a male first name, so it is an example of a man.

clue.text: A quarter say may appear natural

parts.note: E is east, one of the four compass quarters

indicators.note: may appear suggests the letters of say emerge in a different order

explanation.surface: Someone saying a quarter can look effortless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may appear' rearranges SAY to ASY after E (east, a compass quarter).
explanation.definitionFit: Easy can mean relaxed and unforced, as in an easy manner.

clue.text: Enjoy corresponding

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to be fond of; as an adjective it means similar or matching.

clue.text: A home concerned with the environment?

definitions.text: A home concerned with the environment?

parts.words: A home concerned with the environment?
parts.note: read as an eco-friendly house, though it is a glass building for growing plants

explanation.surface: An eco-friendly house.
explanation.definitionFit: A glass building for plants, read as an eco-conscious dwelling.
